backend/main.mo: Motoko backend managing trending content, user profiles, and access control with role checks and storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing features, related files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing purpose and behavior of various frontend files.
frontend/.env.example: Example environment file setting VITE_APP_VERSION to 42.
frontend/.gitignore: Git ignore rules for logs, build artifacts, editor files, and env files.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document loading the React app entrypoint.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app applying theme, authentication, and profile setup, displaying a placeholder message.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component showing credits and external links with attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header component with login/logout logic and app title display.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Dialog prompting new users to enter their name and save their profile.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating authenticated or anonymous backend actors and invalidating related queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, including identity loading, login/logout handling, and status tracking using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and saving the caller's user profile via the actor API.
frontend/src/index.css: TailwindCSS base configuration defining global color variables, theme tokens, and default body styles.
frontend/src/lib/devDiagnostics.ts: Empty placeholder file for development diagnostics.
frontend/src/lib/mediaKeys.ts: Empty placeholder file for media key utilities.
frontend/src/lib/sectionTheme.ts: Empty placeholder file for section theming utilities.
frontend/src/lib/versionGuard.ts: Implements version validation for deterministic builds and exposes a helper to retrieve the current app version.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wiring in React Query and Internet Identity provider before rendering App.
frontend/src/vite-env.d.ts: Type declarations for Vite environment variables, including VITE_APP_VERSION.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration extending theme colors, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Describes current project architecture, features, known issues, and development notes for the CineStream app.
